summary.zh: 立陶宛城市搜索与救援队 LTU-01 于2026年9月7日至11日在立陶宛完成 INSARAG 外部分级认证（IEC），被核定为轻型队。

content.en:
Congratulations to the Lithuanian Urban Search and Rescue Team LTU-01 on successfully completing the INSARAG External Classification (IEC) as a Light team, held from 7 to 11 September 2026 in Lithuania!
This important achievement highlights the team’s strong operational capabilities, professionalism, and commitment to international search and rescue standards.
Hosted in Lithuania, the classification process demonstrated the team’s ability to operate effectively in complex emergency environments and contribute to coordinated international response efforts.
This successful classification reflects Lithuania’s continued commitment to strengthening global emergency response capacity.
The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincere congratulations to the entire LTU-01 team on this significant achievement!
content.zh:
祝贺立陶宛城市搜索与救援队 LTU-01 于2026年9月7日至11日在立陶宛顺利完成 INSARAG 外部分级认证（IEC），被核定为轻型队！
这一重要成就充分彰显了该队扎实的实战能力、专业素养以及对国际搜救标准的严格恪守。
本次在立陶宛主办的分级程序，现场检验了队伍在复杂应急环境下高效作业并参与国际协调响应行动的能力。
此次成功认证体现了立陶宛持续加强全球应急响应能力建设的坚定承诺。
INSARAG 秘书处向 LTU-01 全体队员在这一重要成就上致以诚挚的祝贺！
